notes: Job READACCT step STEP05: CBACT01C reads CardDemo's account master (the ACCTDATA KSDS, acctdata.txt) in key order, DISPLAYs each account, and writes three files per account: OUTFILE (RECFM=FB, LRECL=107; the reissue date reformatted by the assembler routine COBDATFT, CURR-CYC-DEBIT as COMP-3, 2525.00 when it is zero), ARRYFILE (LRECL=110: a 5-entry table, three entries set, the rest as INITIALIZE leaves them) and VBRCFILE (RECFM=VB: a 12-byte and a 39-byte record per account, RECORD VARYING DEPENDING ON WS-RECD-LEN). COBDATFT is the harness's model of app/asm/COBDATFT.asm (tests/equivalence/le/cobdatft.c; oracle_assumptions.md A1). OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE carries two bytes COBDATFT never writes (oracle_assumptions.md L3: GnuCOBOL's spaces). ARRYFILE's untouched table entries are INITIALIZE's zeros, unsigned under GnuCOBOL, with the preferred C sign on z/OS: zoned_sign_equivalent (oracle_assumptions.md C10). The program never CLOSEs its three output files (GOBACK does). Every input is the corpus's data. faults.name: open-acctfile
faults.why: 35: OPEN of a file that is not present (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): 'ERROR OPENING ACCTFILE' from 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: open-acctfile-verified
faults.why: 97: OPEN successful, file integrity verified (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) -- a successful open, but 0000-ACCTFILE-OPEN accepts only '00', so the step abends through 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS's 9 arm, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999
